REED-LIGHT_POWER.title: Luminosity
REED-LIGHT_POWER.description: Your [gold]Flame Light[/gold] cards deal 1 additional damage.
REED-LIGHT_POWER.smartDescription: Your [gold]Flame Light[/gold] cards deal {Amount} additional damage.
REED-AS_TORCH_POWER.title: Like a Torch
REED-AS_TORCH_POWER.description: The next time this creature enters [red]Burning State[/red], its [gold]Spark Cards[/gold] Burst 1 additional time.
REED-AS_TORCH_POWER.smartDescription: The next time this creature enters [red]Burning State[/red], its [gold]Spark Cards[/gold] Burst {Amount} additional times.
REED-HER_FLAME_POWER.title: Her Flame
REED-HER_FLAME_POWER.description: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, [gold]Burn[/gold] a random enemy 1, prioritizing enemies not in Burning State.
REED-HER_FLAME_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, [gold]Burn[/gold] a random enemy {Amount}, prioritizing enemies not in Burning State.
REED-CURSE_HEAL_POWER.title: Curseheal
REED-CURSE_HEAL_POWER.description: Whenever your cards deal damage, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to 25% of the damage dealt.
REED-CURSE_HEAL_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever your cards deal damage, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to {Amount}*25% of the damage dealt.
REED-CHASE_FIRE_POWER.title: Chase the Flame
REED-CHASE_FIRE_POWER.description:
Increase the Spark Card limit to 4.
Whenever you [gold]Burn[/gold] an enemy in [red]Burning State[/red], increase the damage of one of its random Spark Cards by the same amount.
REED-CHASE_FIRE_POWER.smartDescription:
Increase the Spark Card limit to 4.
Whenever you [gold]Burn[/gold] an enemy in [red]Burning State[/red], increase the damage of one of its random Spark Cards by {Amount} times that amount.
REED-HEART_KNOT_POWER.title: Heart Knot
REED-HEART_KNOT_POWER.description: Whenever you play a card automatically, gain [gold]Block[/gold].
REED-HEART_KNOT_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you play a card automatically, gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold].
REED-FROM_HISTORY_POWER.title: From History
REED-FROM_HISTORY_POWER.description: Whenever you [gold]Recall[/gold], record 1 random card in the [blue]Recalled turn's[/blue] Memory.
REED-FROM_HISTORY_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you [gold]Recall[/gold], record {Amount} random cards in the [blue]Recalled turn's[/blue] Memory.
REED-TURBID_BURN_POWER.title: Turbid Flames
REED-TURBID_BURN_POWER.description: Whenever you play an Attack, [gold]Burn[/gold] all creatures.
REED-TURBID_BURN_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you play an Attack, [gold]Burn[/gold] all creatures {Amount}.
REED-NATURAL_HISTORY_POWER.title: Curator
REED-NATURAL_HISTORY_POWER.description: For every 10 cards you [gold]Recall[/gold] or record, draw 1 card.
REED-NATURAL_HISTORY_POWER.smartDescript: For every 10 cards you [gold]Recall[/gold] or record, draw {Amount} cards.
REED-LIGHT_SHADOW_POWER.title: Light and Shadow
REED-LIGHT_SHADOW_POWER.description: Whenever a creature enters or leaves [red]Burning State[/red], add a [gold]Flame Light[/gold] or [gold]Flame Shadow[/gold], respectively, to your hand.
REED-LIGHT_SHADOW_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever a creature enters or leaves [red]Burning State[/red], add {Amount} [gold]Flame Light[/gold] or [gold]Flame Shadow[/gold] cards, respectively, to your hand.
REED-UNTIL_DEATH_POWER.title: Until the Flames Burn Out
REED-UNTIL_DEATH_POWER.description: Whenever an enemy leaves [red]Burning State[/red], trigger the Burst effect of one of its random [gold]Spark[/gold] Cards.
REED-UNTIL_DEATH_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever an enemy leaves [red]Burning State[/red], trigger the Burst effect of one of its random [gold]Spark[/gold] Cards {Amount} times.
REED-WHICH_LIVING_POWER.title: Life and Death
REED-WHICH_LIVING_POWER.description: Transform the Spark Cards you have attached to other creatures into Living or Dying Form.
REED-WHICH_LIVING_POWER.smartDescription: Transform the Spark Cards you have attached to other creatures into {Alive:Living Form, granting you defensive benefits.|Dying Form, granting you offensive benefits.}
REED-STEP_STEP_POWER.title: Keep Moving Forward
REED-STEP_STEP_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Recall[/gold] an Attack or Skill from [blue]turn 1[/blue] of Memory, then advance the turn number by 1.
REED-STEP_STEP_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, [gold]Recall[/gold] an Attack or Skill from [blue]turn {Amount}[/blue] of Memory, then advance the turn number by 1.
REED-LIGHT_FLOW_POWER.title: Flow of Light
REED-LIGHT_FLOW_POWER.description: Whenever you play a card, add a [gold]Flame Light[/gold] to your hand.
REED-LIGHT_FLOW_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you play a card, add {Amount} [gold]Flame Light[/gold] cards to your hand.
REED-RECALL_POWER.title: Pending Recall
REED-RECALL_POWER.description: After you manually play your next card, [gold]Recall[/gold] an Attack or Skill costing no more than 1 from [blue]the previous turn's[/blue] Memory.
REED-RECALL_POWER.smartDescription: After you manually play your next {Amount} cards, [gold]Recall[/gold] an Attack or Skill costing no more than {Amount} from [blue]the previous turn's[/blue] Memory.
REED-DRAGON_CROWN_POWER.title: A Wreath for the Red Dragon
REED-DRAGON_CROWN_POWER.description: You can play and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [gold]Status[/gold] cards in your hand and draw a card, even if those Status cards are unplayable.
REED-DRAGON_CROWN_POWER.smartDescription: For up to {Amount} cards each turn, you can play and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [gold]Status[/gold] cards in your hand and draw a card, even if those Status cards are unplayable.
REED-INC_FIRE_POWER.title: Kindle Anew
REED-INC_FIRE_POWER.description: For each point of [gold]Burn[/gold] this creature receives this turn, increase the damage of one of its random Spark Cards by 1.
REED-INC_FIRE_POWER.smartDescription: For each point of [gold]Burn[/gold] this creature receives this turn, increase the damage of one of its random Spark Cards by {Amount}.
REED-ELEGY_POWER.title: Elegy
REED-ELEGY_POWER.description: Each turn, the first time you [gold]Attach[/gold] a card to a creature, gain [gold]Block[/gold].
REED-ELEGY_POWER.smartDescription: Each turn, the first time you [gold]Attach[/gold] a card to a creature, gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold].
REED-ELEGY_ATTACHED_POWER.title: Elegy Sung
REED-ELEGY_ATTACHED_POWER.description: This creature has already triggered your [gold]Elegy[/gold] this turn.
REED-ELEGY_ATTACHED_POWER.smartDescripti: This creature has already triggered {ApplierName}'s [gold]Elegy[/gold] this turn.
REED-FLAME_SUN_POWER.title: Flame Sun
REED-FLAME_SUN_POWER.description: When you are attacked this turn, [gold]Burn[/gold] the attacker.
REED-FLAME_SUN_POWER.smartDescription: When you are attacked this turn, [gold]Burn[/gold] the attacker {Amount}.
REED-HATE_POWER.title: Red Dragon's Hate
REED-HATE_POWER.description: Until it next leaves [red]Burning State[/red], the Resistance it loses and restores is increased.
REED-HATE_POWER.smartDescription: Until it next leaves [red]Burning State[/red], the Resistance it loses and restores is increased by {Amount}.
